basic_info.description: Classic 2BD/2BA Marina-style home with big square footage in prime Outer Richmond, just steps to Ocean Beach, GGP, Land's End, Safeway & Balboa St hotspots (Andytown, Devil's Teeth & more). 894 48th Ave offers elegant period details, a functional main-level layout & flexible lower-level studio-style space. Main level features a formal entry, light-filled FLR w/ coved ceilings & FP, and a spacious FDR. Roomy eat-in kitchen features a walk-in pantry. Two quiet rear BDs plus full hall BA. Bonus sunroom off rear BD provides ideal flex space for office, nursery or reading nook. Lower level includes a large studio-style area w/ family/media room feel, wet bar, full BA & bonus sitting area - great for guests, creative use or potential expansion. Laundry + 2-car garage w/int access add utility. Cozy rear yd w/paved patio & garden beds, perfect for outdoor dining or gardening. Note: Property is tenant-occupied. All images virtually emptied, enhanced & staged for privacy. Do not disturb occupants.
